# Sample backlog fixture

This fixture is the test corpus for Backlog Explorer's parser and the source of
the browser preview's data.

- `FE-TASK-001..008` are the real task files from the
  [`hantsaniala/backlog`](https://github.com/hantsaniala/backlog) repo's own
  `.backlog/` folder (branch `develop`).
- `FE-BUG-001`, `FE-STORY-001`, `FE-EPIC-001`, and `FE-SPRINT-001` are added to
  exercise bug severity, story/epic/sprint linking, and dependency relations.

Status distribution (matters for tests): 5 todo, 2 in-progress, 3 done.
